In the human world, the Incubus King disguises himself as a human named "Kuroi Ryuuji" {{char}} must never know his real identity unless revealed.

entries.name: Nomad (org)
entries.content: is a multinational corporation that presents itself as a legitimate businesss but in actuality a crime syndicate run by demons. It is known for using demonic tech to sow chaos and corruption upon the human world. It is led by Edwin Black, the Vampire King. The taimanin could not directly attack the company as it is backed by  corrupt politicians across the globe and as well as its near spotless public image thanks to propaganda.

entries.name: Under Eden
entries.content: Under Eden is a high society brothel ran by Real, located on the the underground city of Yomihara. It has connections to various crime syndicates. The sex workers here range from regular prostitute to unwitting sex slaves. Underneath the building’s exterior lies an underground facility where sex slaves are imprisoned and get their bodies and minds conditioned into compliance via brainwashing, drugs and various other methods.

entries.name: Yomihara
entries.content: Yomihara is a large hidden underground city, located below Tokyo. It is known as one of "Hell's Cities". It houses one of the greater Demon Gates that connects it to the Dark World. Connected to the surface by a myriad of Mining tunnels and protected by four huge main gates, this city is a den of scum of villainy full of criminals, demons and all kinds of illegal activities.

entries.name: Gosha Academy
entries.content: Gosha Academy is the headquarters and training ground for Taimanin of Gosha Village.The Academy has many typical rooms and buildings, normal classroom, principal's office, dormitories, baths, swimming pool, large yard and cafeteria. Along with medical research facilities and an underground HQ.

entries.name: Tokyo Kingdom
entries.content: Tokyo Kingdom is located on an artificial island floating from Tokyo bay. Used to have a promising future but was aboandoned due to proxy wars by foreign powers.  It is now a forgotten city, home to many criminals and demons with a now booming black market. It is a hotbed for crime, violence, slavery, and prostitution.

entries.name: Mizuki Mansion
entries.content: {{char}}'s home. A western styled mansion of the Mizuki clan. The building is located away from Gosha Village, in an area near the mountains and forests.{{char}} became the owner of the mansion after her mother went MIA and her father's died shortly afterwards. The mansion is Protected by lesser spirits in the gardens, traps, and the ghost steward Tokirai Zenki.

entries.name: Gosha Village
entries.content: Gosha Village is the headquarters of the Taimanin created by assembling ninja clans across Japan. The village is hidden somewhere in the Kanto region and built near ancient forests and mountains, With a population of 10000 people. The village was built to combat human and demonic threats. It is funded and supervised under The Japanese Government. it is led by the Igawa clan elders with Igawa Asagi as its mayor. Gosha Academy is HQ of the Village.

entries.name: Edwin Black
entries.content: The pragmatic, cold and calculating  immortal Vampire King. He is the CEO  Nomad. He is obsessed with Igawa Asagi and wishes to corrupt her, hoping to be the "Adam and Eve" of the new universes he is able to create, with his powers. The only one who knows how dangerous {{user}} is.
